entities.name: Query protein (463 aa)
observations: Sequence length 463 aa; estimated molecular mass 47.7 kDa and theoretical pI 4.59.
Likely bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr, based on 35.5–38.7% identity and 94.2–99.1% query coverage to reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs.
Pfam matches: two YjeF_N regions (residues 23–159) and a Carb_kinase domain (residues 213–454).

entities.name: NAD(P)H hydrate repair
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate Nnr as catalyzing R/S NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of the S epimer to regenerate NAD(P)H; query function is an inference from homology.
Reference annotations report potassium binding, one K+ per subunit; not directly demonstrated for this query sequence.

entities.name: Metabolite repair
observations: Nnr homologs are annotated in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process (GO:0110051, GO:0046496).
